utility.notes: Morro Bay is a well-documented San Luis Obispo County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

value.name: Central Coast Community Energy (3CE)
value.notes: 3CE's own official site confirms it serves San Luis Obispo County, and separately lists Morro Bay among its named member communities. PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

permit_authority.value: City of Morro Bay Building Division

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Morro Bay/San Luis Obispo County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.notes: Processing via the Symbium automated platform (SB 379 compliance) takes approximately 1-3 business days, depending on staff availability.

other_conditions: Three permit categories exist: Solar Residential OL, Solar with ESS Residential OL, and ESS Only Residential OL
Effective January 1, 2025, the Symbium portal became the exclusive submission method

rebates.notes: The city separately operates a Green Building Incentive Program offering building/plan-check fee rebates and expedited review, but specific solar-applicable rebate amounts were not confirmed this session.
